plan.notes: Source: TMCC official catalog 'Chemistry, AS' (https://catalog.tmcc.edu/degrees-certificates/chemistry-as/), 'Recommended Course Schedule' plan-of-study grid (Chemistry Career Map), hand-transcribed 2026-10-02. The catalog defines its plan footnotes on this page: 3 = 'See approved General Education list for the AA/AS Degree', 4 = 'See program recommendations or requirements' — unspecified slots are modeled as choice slots with those definitions in choice_note; see advisor. The published 3rd-semester grid lists the program-recommendation slot as 4-7 units; it is modeled at 4 units so the semester reconciles to the published semester total of 15 (see advisor if more units are taken). Combined lecture+lab rows (PHYS 180 & 180L, PHYS 181 & 181L) are split into separate course entries totaling the published combined units. Per-course prerequisites are not listed in the schedule grid.
